paragraphs.text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
paragraphs.original: Τότε ὁμοιωθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν δέκα παρθένοις, αἵτινες λαβοῦσαι τὰς λαμπάδας ἑαυτῶν ἐξῆλθον εἰς ὑπάντησιν τοῦ νυμφίου.
paragraphs.translit: Tote homoiōthēsetai hē basileia tōn ouranōn deka parthenois, haitines labousai tas lampadas heautōn exēlthon eis hypantēsin tou nymphiou.

paragraphs.text: And five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
paragraphs.original: πέντε δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἦσαν μωραὶ καὶ πέντε φρόνιμοι.
paragraphs.translit: pente de ex autōn ēsan mōrai kai pente phronimoi.

paragraphs.text: For the foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them:
paragraphs.original: αἱ γὰρ μωραὶ λαβοῦσαι τὰς λαμπάδας αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔλαβον μεθʼ ἑαυτῶν ἔλαιον·
paragraphs.translit: hai gar mōrai labousai tas lampadas autōn ouk elabon methʼ heautōn elaion·

paragraphs.text: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
paragraphs.original: αἱ δὲ φρόνιμοι ἔλαβον ἔλαιον ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις μετὰ τῶν λαμπάδων ἑαυτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hai de phronimoi elabon elaion en tois angeiois meta tōn lampadōn heautōn.

paragraphs.text: Now while the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
paragraphs.original: χρονίζοντος δὲ τοῦ νυμφίου ἐνύσταξαν πᾶσαι καὶ ἐκάθευδον.
paragraphs.translit: chronizontos de tou nymphiou enystaxan pasai kai ekatheudon.

paragraphs.text: But at midnight there is a cry, Behold, the bridegroom! Come ye forth to meet him.
paragraphs.original: μέσης δὲ νυκτὸς κραυγὴ γέγονεν· Ἰδοὺ ὁ νυμφίος, ἐξέρχεσθε εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: mesēs de nyktos kraugē gegonen· Idou ho nymphios, exerchesthe eis apantēsin autou.

paragraphs.text: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
paragraphs.original: τότε ἠγέρθησαν πᾶσαι αἱ παρθένοι ἐκεῖναι καὶ ἐκόσμησαν τὰς λαμπάδας ἑαυτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: tote ēgerthēsan pasai hai parthenoi ekeinai kai ekosmēsan tas lampadas heautōn.

paragraphs.text: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are going out.
paragraphs.original: αἱ δὲ μωραὶ ταῖς φρονίμοις εἶπαν· Δότε ἡμῖν ἐκ τοῦ ἐλαίου ὑμῶν, ὅτι αἱ λαμπάδες ἡμῶν σβέννυνται.
paragraphs.translit: hai de mōrai tais phronimois eipan· Dote hēmin ek tou elaiou hymōn, hoti hai lampades hēmōn sbennyntai.

paragraphs.text: But the wise answered, saying, Peradventure there will not be enough for us and you: go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν δὲ αἱ φρόνιμοι λέγουσαι· Μήποτε οὐ μὴ ἀρκέσῃ ἡμῖν καὶ ὑμῖν· πορεύεσθε μᾶλλον πρὸς τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ ἀγοράσατε ἑαυταῖς.
paragraphs.translit: apekrithēsan de hai phronimoi legousai· Mēpote ou mē arkesē hēmin kai hymin· poreuesthe mallon pros tous pōlountas kai agorasate heautais.

paragraphs.text: And while they went away to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage feast: and the door was shut.
paragraphs.original: ἀπερχομένων δὲ αὐτῶν ἀγοράσαι ἦλθεν ὁ νυμφίος, καὶ αἱ ἕτοιμοι εἰσῆλθον μετʼ αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς γάμους, καὶ ἐκλείσθη ἡ θύρα.
paragraphs.translit: aperchomenōn de autōn agorasai ēlthen ho nymphios, kai hai hetoimoi eisēlthon metʼ autou eis tous gamous, kai ekleisthē hē thyra.

paragraphs.text: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
paragraphs.original: ὕστερον δὲ ἔρχονται καὶ αἱ λοιπαὶ παρθένοι λέγουσαι· Κύριε κύριε, ἄνοιξον ἡμῖν·
paragraphs.translit: hysteron de erchontai kai hai loipai parthenoi legousai· Kyrie kyrie, anoixon hēmin·

paragraphs.text: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: ho de apokritheis eipen· Amēn legō hymin, ouk oida hymas.

paragraphs.text: Watch therefore, for ye know not the day nor the hour.
paragraphs.original: γρηγορεῖτε οὖν, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἡμέραν οὐδὲ τὴν ὥραν.
paragraphs.translit: grēgoreite oun, hoti ouk oidate tēn hēmeran oude tēn hōran.

paragraphs.text: For [it is] as [when] a man, going into another country, called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
paragraphs.original: Ὥσπερ γὰρ ἄνθρωπος ἀποδημῶν ἐκάλεσεν τοὺς ἰδίους δούλους καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοῖς τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Hōsper gar anthrōpos apodēmōn ekalesen tous idious doulous kai paredōken autois ta hyparchonta autou,

paragraphs.text: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his several ability; and he went on his journey.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ᾧ μὲν ἔδωκεν πέντε τάλαντα ᾧ δὲ δύο ᾧ δὲ ἕν, ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὴν ἰδίαν δύναμιν, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν. εὐθέως
paragraphs.translit: kai hō men edōken pente talanta hō de dyo hō de hen, hekastō kata tēn idian dynamin, kai apedēmēsen. eutheōs

paragraphs.text: Straightway he that received the five talents went and traded with them, and made other five talents.
paragraphs.original: πορευθεὶς ὁ τὰ πέντε τάλαντα λαβὼν ἠργάσατο ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐκέρδησεν ἄλλα πέντε·
paragraphs.translit: poreutheis ho ta pente talanta labōn ērgasato en autois kai ekerdēsen alla pente·

paragraphs.text: In like manner he also that [received] the two gained other two.
paragraphs.original: ὡσαύτως ὁ τὰ δύο ἐκέρδησεν ἄλλα δύο·
paragraphs.translit: hōsautōs ho ta dyo ekerdēsen alla dyo·

paragraphs.text: But he that received the one went away and digged in the earth, and hid his lord`s money.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ τὸ ἓν λαβὼν ἀπελθὼν ὤρυξεν γῆν καὶ ἔκρυψεν τὸ ἀργύριον τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ho de to hen labōn apelthōn ōryxen gēn kai ekrypsen to argyrion tou kyriou autou.

paragraphs.text: Now after a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and maketh a reckoning with them.
paragraphs.original: μετὰ δὲ πολὺν χρόνον ἔρχεται ὁ κύριος τῶν δούλων ἐκείνων καὶ συναίρει λόγον μετʼ αὐτῶν
paragraphs.translit: meta de polyn chronon erchetai ho kyrios tōn doulōn ekeinōn kai synairei logon metʼ autōn

paragraphs.text: And he that received the five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: lo, I have gained other five talents.
paragraphs.original: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ τὰ πέντε τάλαντα λαβὼν προσήνεγκεν ἄλλα πέντε τάλαντα λέγων· Κύριε, πέντε τάλαντά μοι παρέδωκας· ἴδε ἄλλα πέντε τάλαντα ἐκέρδησα.
paragraphs.translit: kai proselthōn ho ta pente talanta labōn prosēnenken alla pente talanta legōn· Kyrie, pente talanta moi paredōkas· ide alla pente talanta ekerdēsa.

paragraphs.text: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
paragraphs.original: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ· Εὖ, δοῦλε ἀγαθὲ καὶ πιστέ, ἐπὶ ὀλίγα ἦς πιστός, ἐπὶ πολλῶν σε καταστήσω· εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν χαρὰν τοῦ κυρίου σου.
paragraphs.translit: ephē autō ho kyrios autou· Eu, doule agathe kai piste, epi oliga ēs pistos, epi pollōn se katastēsō· eiselthe eis tēn charan tou kyriou sou.

paragraphs.text: And he also that [received] the two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: lo, I have gained other two talents.
paragraphs.original: προσελθὼν δὲ καὶ ὁ τὰ δύο τάλαντα εἶπεν· Κύριε, δύο τάλαντά μοι παρέδωκας· ἴδε ἄλλα δύο τάλαντα ἐκέρδησα.
paragraphs.translit: proselthōn de kai ho ta dyo talanta eipen· Kyrie, dyo talanta moi paredōkas· ide alla dyo talanta ekerdēsa.

paragraphs.text: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
paragraphs.original: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ· Εὖ, δοῦλε ἀγαθὲ καὶ πιστέ, ἐπὶ ὀλίγα ἦς πιστός, ἐπὶ πολλῶν σε καταστήσω· εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν χαρὰν τοῦ κυρίου σου.
paragraphs.translit: ephē autō ho kyrios autou· Eu, doule agathe kai piste, epi oliga ēs pistos, epi pollōn se katastēsō· eiselthe eis tēn charan tou kyriou sou.

paragraphs.text: And he also that had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou didst not sow, and gathering where thou didst not scatter;
paragraphs.original: προσελθὼν δὲ καὶ ὁ τὸ ἓν τάλαντον εἰληφὼς εἶπεν· Κύριε, ἔγνων σε ὅτι σκληρὸς εἶ ἄνθρωπος, θερίζων ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρας καὶ συνάγων ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισας·
paragraphs.translit: proselthōn de kai ho to hen talanton eilēphōs eipen· Kyrie, egnōn se hoti sklēros ei anthrōpos, therizōn hopou ouk espeiras kai synagōn hothen ou dieskorpisas·

paragraphs.text: and I was afraid, and went away and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, thou hast thine own.
paragraphs.original: καὶ φοβηθεὶς ἀπελθὼν ἔκρυψα τὸ τάλαντόν σου ἐν τῇ γῇ· ἴδε ἔχεις τὸ σόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai phobētheis apelthōn ekrypsa to talanton sou en tē gē· ide echeis to son.

paragraphs.text: But his lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I did not scatter;
paragraphs.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Πονηρὲ δοῦλε καὶ ὀκνηρέ, ᾔδεις ὅτι θερίζω ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρα καὶ συνάγω ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισα;
paragraphs.translit: apokritheis de ho kyrios autou eipen autō· Ponēre doule kai oknēre, ēdeis hoti therizō hopou ouk espeira kai synagō hothen ou dieskorpisa;

paragraphs.text: thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back mine own with interest.
paragraphs.original: ἔδει σε οὖν βαλεῖν τὰ ἀργύριά μου τοῖς τραπεζίταις, καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐγὼ ἐκομισάμην ἂν τὸ ἐμὸν σὺν τόκῳ.
paragraphs.translit: edei se oun balein ta argyria mou tois trapezitais, kai elthōn egō ekomisamēn an to emon syn tokō.

paragraphs.text: Take ye away therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him that hath the ten talents.
paragraphs.original: ἄρατε οὖν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ τὸ τάλαντον καὶ δότε τῷ ἔχοντι τὰ δέκα τάλαντα·
paragraphs.translit: arate oun apʼ autou to talanton kai dote tō echonti ta deka talanta·

paragraphs.text: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away.
paragraphs.original: τῷ γὰρ ἔχοντι παντὶ δοθήσεται καὶ περισσευθήσεται· τοῦ δὲ μὴ ἔχοντος καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: tō gar echonti panti dothēsetai kai perisseuthēsetai· tou de mē echontos kai ho echei arthēsetai apʼ autou.

paragraphs.text: And cast ye out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
paragraphs.original: καὶ τὸν ἀχρεῖον δοῦλον ἐκβάλετε εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον· ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.
paragraphs.translit: kai ton achreion doulon ekbalete eis to skotos to exōteron· ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brygmos tōn odontōn.

paragraphs.text: But when the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the angels with him, then shall he sit on the throne of his glory:
paragraphs.original: Ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι μετʼ αὐτοῦ, τότε καθίσει ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: Hotan de elthē ho hyios tou anthrōpou en tē doxē autou kai pantes hoi angeloi metʼ autou, tote kathisei epi thronou doxēs autou·

paragraphs.text: and before him shall be gathered all the nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as the shepherd separateth the sheep from the goats;
paragraphs.original: καὶ συναχθήσονται ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ ἀφορίσει αὐτοὺς ἀπʼ ἀλλήλων, ὥσπερ ὁ ποιμὴν ἀφορίζει τὰ πρόβατα ἀπὸ τῶν ἐρίφων,
paragraphs.translit: kai synachthēsontai emprosthen autou panta ta ethnē, kai aphorisei autous apʼ allēlōn, hōsper ho poimēn aphorizei ta probata apo tōn eriphōn,

paragraphs.text: and he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
paragraphs.original: καὶ στήσει τὰ μὲν πρόβατα ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ τὰ δὲ ἐρίφια ἐξ εὐωνύμων.
paragraphs.translit: kai stēsei ta men probata ek dexiōn autou ta de eriphia ex euōnymōn.

paragraphs.text: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
paragraphs.original: τότε ἐρεῖ ὁ βασιλεὺς τοῖς ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ· Δεῦτε, οἱ εὐλογημένοι τοῦ πατρός μου, κληρονομήσατε τὴν ἡτοιμασμένην ὑμῖν βασιλείαν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου.
paragraphs.translit: tote erei ho basileus tois ek dexiōn autou· Deute, hoi eulogēmenoi tou patros mou, klēronomēsate tēn hētoimasmenēn hymin basileian apo katabolēs kosmou.

paragraphs.text: for I was hungry, and ye gave me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink; I was a stranger, and ye took me in;
paragraphs.original: ἐπείνασα γὰρ καὶ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν, ἐδίψησα καὶ ἐποτίσατέ με, ξένος ἤμην καὶ συνηγάγετέ με,
paragraphs.translit: epeinasa gar kai edōkate moi phagein, edipsēsa kai epotisate me, xenos ēmēn kai synēgagete me,

paragraphs.text: naked, and ye clothed me; I was sick, and ye visited me; I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
paragraphs.original: γυμνὸς καὶ περιεβάλετέ με, ἠσθένησα καὶ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με, ἐν φυλακῇ ἤμην καὶ ἤλθατε πρός με.
paragraphs.translit: gymnos kai periebalete me, ēsthenēsa kai epeskepsasthe me, en phylakē ēmēn kai ēlthate pros me.

paragraphs.text: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, and fed thee? or athirst, and gave thee drink?
paragraphs.original: τότε ἀποκριθήσονται αὐτῷ οἱ δίκαιοι λέγοντες· Κύριε, πότε σε εἴδομεν πεινῶντα καὶ ἐθρέψαμεν, ἢ διψῶντα καὶ ἐποτίσαμεν;
paragraphs.translit: tote apokrithēsontai autō hoi dikaioi legontes· Kyrie, pote se eidomen peinōnta kai ethrepsamen, ē dipsōnta kai epotisamen;

paragraphs.text: And when saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
paragraphs.original: πότε δέ σε εἴδομεν ξένον καὶ συνηγάγομεν, ἢ γυμνὸν καὶ περιεβάλομεν;
paragraphs.translit: pote de se eidomen xenon kai synēgagomen, ē gymnon kai periebalomen;

paragraphs.text: And when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
paragraphs.original: πότε δέ σε εἴδομεν ἀσθενοῦντα ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ ἤλθομεν πρός σε;
paragraphs.translit: pote de se eidomen asthenounta ē en phylakē kai ēlthomen pros se;

paragraphs.text: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it unto one of these my brethren, [even] these least, ye did it unto me.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐρεῖ αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐφʼ ὅσον ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τούτων τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου τῶν ἐλαχίστων, ἐμοὶ ἐποιήσατε.
paragraphs.translit: kai apokritheis ho basileus erei autois· Amēn legō hymin, ephʼ hoson epoiēsate heni toutōn tōn adelphōn mou tōn elachistōn, emoi epoiēsate.

paragraphs.text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels:
paragraphs.original: τότε ἐρεῖ καὶ τοῖς ἐξ εὐωνύμων· Πορεύεσθε ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ οἱ κατηραμένοι εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ αἰώνιον τὸ ἡτοιμασμένον τῷ διαβόλῳ καὶ τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: tote erei kai tois ex euōnymōn· Poreuesthe apʼ emou hoi katēramenoi eis to pyr to aiōnion to hētoimasmenon tō diabolō kai tois angelois autou.

paragraphs.text: for I was hungry, and ye did not give me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink;
paragraphs.original: ἐπείνασα γὰρ καὶ οὐκ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν, ἐδίψησα καὶ οὐκ ἐποτίσατέ με,
paragraphs.translit: epeinasa gar kai ouk edōkate moi phagein, edipsēsa kai ouk epotisate me,

paragraphs.text: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in; naked, and ye clothed me not; sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
paragraphs.original: ξένος ἤμην καὶ οὐ συνηγάγετέ με, γυμνὸς καὶ οὐ περιεβάλετέ με, ἀσθενὴς καὶ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐκ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με.
paragraphs.translit: xenos ēmēn kai ou synēgagete me, gymnos kai ou periebalete me, asthenēs kai en phylakē kai ouk epeskepsasthe me.

paragraphs.text: Then shall they also answer, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
paragraphs.original: τότε ἀποκριθήσονται καὶ αὐτοὶ λέγοντες· Κύριε, πότε σε εἴδομεν πεινῶντα ἢ διψῶντα ἢ ξένον ἢ γυμνὸν ἢ ἀσθενῆ ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐ διηκονήσαμέν σοι;
paragraphs.translit: tote apokrithēsontai kai autoi legontes· Kyrie, pote se eidomen peinōnta ē dipsōnta ē xenon ē gymnon ē asthenē ē en phylakē kai ou diēkonēsamen soi;

paragraphs.text: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not unto one of these least, ye did it not unto me.
paragraphs.original: τότε ἀποκριθήσεται αὐτοῖς λέγων· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐφʼ ὅσον οὐκ ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τούτων τῶν ἐλαχίστων, οὐδὲ ἐμοὶ ἐποιήσατε.
paragraphs.translit: tote apokrithēsetai autois legōn· Amēn legō hymin, ephʼ hoson ouk epoiēsate heni toutōn tōn elachistōn, oude emoi epoiēsate.

paragraphs.text: And these shall go away into eternal punishment: but the righteous into eternal life.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀπελεύσονται οὗτοι εἰς κόλασιν αἰώνιον, οἱ δὲ δίκαιοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
paragraphs.translit: kai apeleusontai houtoi eis kolasin aiōnion, hoi de dikaioi eis zōēn aiōnion.
